name: Cosmic Sky
description: Pure black Spotify with a living starfield: drifting, twinkling stars and the occasional tiny comet. Also clears cover-coloured bands on playlist pages.

name: Cosmic Motion
description: Animations for Cosmic: pages and cards ease in, hover lifts, a like pops, and the sky reacts to the music (comet on every new track, stars slow on pause and flash on the beat).

name: Cosmic Now Playing
description: Big cover, karaoke-style synced lyrics and its own player bar. Opens in the main area from a player-bar button, or fullscreen. Stars or blurred-cover background.

name: Cosmic Miniplayer
description: A new look for the mini-player window: stars and comets, small cover, always-visible controls, draggable seek bar.

name: Cosmic Fullscreen F11
description: Toggle Spotify fullscreen with F11 or a top bar button. Esc exits.
